_about: Which reckoning the engine uses. Every choice here changes what is computed, so every choice is shown on screen next to the result it governs.

basis.note: 23° 15′ 00.658″ at 1956-03-21 0h is a true value; the mean ayanāṁśa is that less the nutation in longitude on that date. Measured against the independent oracle: within 0.25″ from 1900 to 2100.

basis.note: Amānta months end at new moon; pūrṇimānta months end at full moon, so the dark fortnight carries the next month's name.
True is the osculating node from the lunar series; within about 1′ of the oracle.
Schools differ between 360, 365.25 and 365.2425 days; the choice moves daśā dates by days per decade.
